profileText: a Representative from Pennsylvania; born in Philadelphia, Philadelphia County, Pa., February 6, 1977; graduated from Cardinal Dougherty High School, Philadelphia, Pa., 1995; B.A., University of Notre Dame, Notre Dame, Ind., 1999; M.P.P., Harvard University Kennedy School of Government, Cambridge, Mass., 2005; radio broadcaster; management consultant; adjunct professor, Drexel University, Philadelphia, Pa.; member of the Pennsylvania state house of representatives, 2008-2014; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Fourteenth and to the five succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2015-present).
